title: Position Papyrus as agent-accessible publishing on the marketing site
description: Ryan, 2026-10-20: agent accessibility is a core feature and part of Papyrus's positioning. On the Papyrus marketing site (p.apyr.us): a feature section/page explaining that every Papyrus site is readable by agents and people alike: per-page Markdown, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, Accept: text/markdown negotiation, page actions (Copy Markdown, open in AI assistants), RSS/Atom, sitemap and structured data; agents operating the newsroom through the CLI and API; roadmap: MCP and WebMCP. Include it in the homepage positioning and the features list (PPY-b9b038). Ship after PPY-f172d7 and the page-actions story are live, with real examples from a live site.
